appName.description: Extension name. Product name; keep untranslated.

htmlLang.description: BCP-47 language tag of THIS catalog. Resolved through Chrome's fallback chain so the popup's <html lang> always matches the language actually rendered, not the browser UI locale.

appDescription.message: Reloads tabs across every window and fetches fresh files instead of reusing saved copies, with best-effort media restoration.
appDescription.description: Extension description shown in the Chrome Web Store and on chrome://extensions.

actionRefreshAll.description: Label of the primary button that starts a refresh.

actionCancel.description: Label of the button that cancels a running refresh.

refreshExplanation.message: Reloads the tabs it can and fetches fresh files instead of reusing copies Chrome saved earlier. Your site data stays in place.
refreshExplanation.description: Short explanation under the buttons describing what a refresh does.

progressLabel.description: Accessible name of the progress bar.

statusRefreshingTabs.description: Initial status line before the first progress update arrives.

statusStarting.description: Status shown while the refresh request is being sent.

statusCancelling.description: Status shown while a cancellation request is being sent.

statusCancelFailed.message: This reload could not be stopped.
statusCancelFailed.description: Status shown when cancellation was rejected.

statusStartFailed.description: Status shown when the refresh could not be started.

statusProcessedInitial.description: Status shown right after the tab list is known and before any tab is processed.

statusProgress.description: Live progress status during a refresh.

statusCancelled.description: Final status after the user cancelled the refresh.

statusCompleteMixed.description: Final status when at least one tab failed.

statusCompleteSkipped.description: Final status when nothing failed but some tabs were skipped.

statusCompleteAll.description: Final status when Chrome accepted a reload for every tab.

statusInterrupted.message: The last reload stopped before it finished.
statusInterrupted.description: Status shown when a refresh did not finish before the worker stopped.

errorInterruptedTitle.description: Error box heading for an interrupted refresh.

errorInterruptedDetail.message: Start again when you are ready.
errorInterruptedDetail.description: Error box detail for an interrupted refresh.

errorStartTitle.description: Error box heading when the refresh never began.

errorFailedSummaryOne.description: Error box heading when exactly one tab failed.

errorFailedSummaryOther.description: Error box heading when two or more tabs failed.

errorTabLine.description: One line of the per-tab failure list.

errorNoTabDetails.message: No tab-specific error details were returned.
errorNoTabDetails.description: Shown when a failure has no per-tab detail.

tabFallbackTitle.description: Placeholder name for a tab with no title.

tabAriaLabel.description: Accessible name of one tab indicator square.

tabStatusPending.description: Tab indicator state: not processed yet.

tabStatusSuccess.description: Tab indicator state: Chrome accepted the reload.

tabStatusSkipped.description: Tab indicator state: the tab was skipped.

historyToggle.description: Button that expands the local refresh history.

historyUnknownDate.description: Shown when a history entry has an unreadable timestamp.

historyEntryCancelled.description: History line for a cancelled refresh.

historyEntrySummary.description: History line for a completed refresh.

statsToggle.description: Button that expands the locally measured saved-file figures.

statsTodayLabel.description: Label for the cache statistics row for the current local date.

statsLastRunLabel.description: Label for the cache statistics row for the most recent refresh operation.

statsWeekLabel.description: Label for the cache statistics row for the current and previous six local dates.

statsMonthLabel.description: Label for the cache statistics row for the current and previous 29 local dates.

statsTotalLabel.description: Label for the all-time measured byte total.

statsAtLeastPrefix.description: Small qualifier shown before a lower-bound cache statistic value.

statsRunLine.message: At least $SIZE$ came from copies Chrome saved earlier and will now be downloaded again.
statsRunLine.description: Completion line showing files measured from copies Chrome saved earlier during the latest reload.

statsResetAction.description: Button that clears locally stored cache statistics.

statsNote.message: Every figure is at least the amount shown. The real number is higher because some files do not tell the page their size, and Chrome keeps only a limited number of the page's load records. Refresh Em All measures these figures in your browser and sends them nowhere.
statsNote.description: Privacy and measurement-limit note below the cache statistics.

permissionGrantAction.description: Button that requests permission to read refreshed pages for best-effort media restoration and saved-file measurement.

permissionGrantExplain.message: This optional permission lets Refresh Em All read the pages you refresh. It uses the permission to keep videos and audio where you left them on a best-effort basis, and to measure files Chrome served from saved copies. Reloading works if you say no.
permissionGrantExplain.description: Explanation shown beside the optional page-reading permission button.

statsAccessHint.message: No new data is being measured because Refresh Em All does not have permission to read the pages you refresh.
statsAccessHint.description: Notice shown above the saved-file figures while optional page-reading permission is missing.

settingsToggle.description: Button that expands the settings and privacy section.

privacyNotice.message: This extension sends no browsing data, measurements, or error reports anywhere. For best-effort playback restoration, it briefly keeps the page's own media settings in temporary storage that clears with the tab; the page can read them until they are cleared.
privacyNotice.description: Privacy statement inside the settings section.

errorOperationInProgress.message: Your tabs are already being reloaded
errorOperationInProgress.description: Reason returned when a refresh is requested while one is running.

errorNoTabs.message: There are no tabs to reload
errorNoTabs.description: Reason returned when the browser reported no tabs.

errorNoRefreshableTabs.message: Chrome did not return any tabs this extension can reload
errorNoRefreshableTabs.description: Reason returned when every reported tab was unusable.

errorStartGeneric.message: Could not start reloading your tabs
errorStartGeneric.description: Fallback reason when the refresh could not be started.

errorStartFailureTabTitle.description: Title of the synthetic failure entry recorded when a refresh never began.

errorReloadFailed.description: Fallback reason when Chrome rejected a reload without a message.

errorUnknownDuringRefresh.message: Something went wrong while reloading the tab
errorUnknownDuringRefresh.description: Generic fallback error text raised while refreshing a tab.

errorRefreshTimeout.message: Timed out refreshing tab after $SECONDS$ seconds
errorRefreshTimeout.description: Reason recorded when a single tab refresh exceeded its time budget.

errorTabRefreshFailed.description: Fallback per-tab failure reason sent to the popup.
